name: 유형-토큰 비율 (TTR)
description: Computes the ratio of unique words to total words using MATTR variant 감지하기 위해 AI 생성 text's vocabulary 패턴.
useCase: Detecting AI text through abnormal 어휘 다양성 ratios 에 걸친 text segments
mechanism: 계산합니다 the Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio (MATTR) using a sliding window approach to mitigate text length effects. For each window of N words, the ratio of unique types to total tokens is computed, then averaged. AI 생성 text often exhibits more uniform TTR values 에 걸친 windows compared to 인간 글쓰기, 는 naturally varies in vocabulary richness 사이의 different sections due to topic shifts and stylistic changes.
source: Covington, M. A. & McFall, J. D. (2010) - Cutting the Gordian Knot: The Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio (MATTR), Journal of Quantitative Linguistics
algorithm: Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio (MATTR) + Variance Analysis + Segment Comparison
parameters: 윈도우 크기: 50-100 tokens, Metrics: mean MATTR, MATTR 분산, MATTR range, Normalization: length-independent
strengths:
• Length-independent measurement via MATTR
• Well-established psycholinguistic metric
• Fast computation with minimal resources
• Captures vocabulary usage 패턴
limitations:
• Lower discriminative power as standalone 특징
• Sensitive to text genre and topic
• Advanced LLMs increasingly match human TTR ranges
• Window size selection affects results
